meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求清理无用代码时，它会扫描整个项目，找出没有被引用的变量、函数、导入和文件；每个候选都用引用检查复核，然后按文件分组，并行派多个后台代理删除；每组改动独立提交一次，最后验证类型检查、测试和构建通过。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等清理相关词，或直接要求清理无用代码时触发。

say.text: 清理这个项目里的死代码。
say.note: 触发全量扫描并移除无用代码。

say.text: 只清理 src/features 目录下的死代码。
say.note: 只处理该目录内的死代码。

say.text: 找出未使用的参数，改成下划线前缀，不要直接删。
say.note: 参数保留但会加下划线前缀。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when asked to clean up unused code, it scans for unreferenced code, verifies each item via reference lookup, batches by file, and deletes via parallel agents. Each batch committed separately; typecheck, tests, and build run at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', or otherwise ask to clean up unused code.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project.
say_en.note: Full scan and removal of unused code are triggered.

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/features.
say_en.note: Scope is limited to that directory.

say_en.text: Find unused parameters and prefix them with '_' instead of deleting.
say_en.note: Parameters are retained with a '_' prefix.
